high_level_description: The image depicts a person standing on a balcony with a scenic view of a cityscape in the background. The individual is wearing a black, textured long-sleeved top paired with a gray skirt. They have long, dark hair that is partially tied back. The person is leaning against the glass railing of the balcony, with one arm extended outward. The setting appears to be an urban environment, as evidenced by the buildings, trees, and a body of water visible through the glass panels. In the distance, there is a prominent tower or structure, possibly a landmark, which adds to the cityscape.
